excluded_paths_reason: Per Section 6, the method commit must contain the provenance audit code/tests/inventory/harness but no real repeat outputs; those are committed separately, after this attestation, as the RESULT commit.

repeat_already_computed_locally_before_t.justification: The deterministic D0.6 repeat (Section 7) was computed in a throwaway git worktree pinned to the already-immutable, already-pushed commit 69d7d90, using only code that was already frozen and committed before this checkpoint began. Nothing in CORRECTION_METHOD_COMMIT or this attestation could have influenced that repeat's output, because the repeat does not execute or import any file from this checkpoint -- it runs scripts/run_d0_6_diagnostics.py exactly as committed at 69d7d90, against data frozen before 69d7d90. The method-freeze concern Section 6/7 exists to prevent (a moving scientific method influencing results before being locked) does not apply retroactively to a repeat of an already-fixed historical commit. The repeat's numeric outputs are committed, unmodified, in the RESULT commit that follows this attestation.
